items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: my first trip over there was with Milt Buckner

ctx.x: Hey, in recent years, you've been doing quite a bit of traveling in Europe. How did you like Europe and who did you play with over there, Panama?

Well, my first trip over there was with Milt Buckner, and Arnett Cobb, Tiny Grimes, and a bass player from France named Roland Lavesoir, and I was very much impressed with the people in Europe by the way they accepted jazz.

And I made quite a few friends over there. Especially, like, people in France, and I have been going back there since 1973, and in fact, I'm getting ready to go there now with my own band; I'm taking my band over there in January of 1979.
